# Rafael Neto

> Blog técnico de Rafael Neto, programador Full Stack: arquitectura de software, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML y CSS. Technical blog by Rafael Neto, Full Stack developer, about software architecture, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.

Posts are written in Spanish first and many have an English translation. Every post is available as clean Markdown: replace the trailing slash of its URL with `.md`. Each Markdown copy lists its author, dates, tags and the URL of its translation.

The full text of every post is in [llms-full.txt](https://rafaelneto.dev/llms-full.txt).
